player_prompt.intro:
I ye jɛgɛ {player_id} kɔnɔ Nim.
I ka ɲɛnɛ kɛ i ye kɔrɔtɔ bɛɛ lajɛ. Kɔnɔ kɔnɔ, tɛgɛ pili pile kelen kɔnɔ ka kɔrɔtɔ caman bɔ pili la.
Kɛrɛ fɔrɔmati '[pile quantity]', pili pile bɛɛ lajɛ ka kɔrɔtɔ bɛɛ lajɛ.
Kɔrɔtɔ fɔrɛ, '[0 3]' bɔ kɔrɔtɔ 3 pili pile 0 la.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Foyi ma sɔrɔ min ka ɲi. I ye '[pile quantity]' kɛ a la.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Jɛgɛ {player_id}, kɛlɛ kɔrɔtɔ. Kolɔn {col} tɛ sɛ ka kɛ.
invalid_move.non_positive: A ka ɲi k'a to fɛɛn dɔ be bɔ a la.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: I ka baara {quantity} kɔnɔ pile {pile_index} (ni {pile_count} dɛn sɔrɔ).

observation.removed_from_piles: Jɛgɛ {player_id} kɛlɛ [{pile_index} {quantity}], bɔ kɔrɔtɔ {quantity} pili {pile_index} la.

outcome.win: Jurusɛbɛbaga {player_id} ye fɛɛn laban min ta o lo!
